text: About 10 o'clock in the morning I was spreading those manure.
I saw an agate field up back the barn there and I kept seeing this glitter and saying it was about a
pretty darn mile away I guess up on top of the hill. There was nothing in view.
I mean in the wet air it's all open ground and there's an old ice box up there where there's something reflected off of that.
It looked just like a mirror shiner in my face there.
and I was going up the top of that hill to see if I was ready to plow anyway,
and I drove on up to the tractor,
and as I got up there about 100 feet of this glistening thing,
if I could see what it was,
well, I got 100, 200 yards from it there,
and I couldn't see nothing.
There wasn't no shining or nothing,
but as I went closer, I got within 100 feet before I saw anything.
This was when I took off.
It was about 100 feet, and I couldn't see it.
It was gone.
I mean, but it looked like a wing tank to me at first.
I'd seen them when I was in the service quite a bit,
fruit tanks off these planes.
Yeah, so was it then the kind of cigar shape that these tip tanks are?
Oh, it was more A-shaped than anything.
It was about 20 foot long, 15 or 16 foot wide, and about 4 foot deep.
How close did you get to it?
A couple inches. I was touching it for about two hours.
What did the surface look like it was made out of?
It was all aluminum colored, whitish colored.
It had a whitish cast to it, but it wasn't bright.
It was shiny, but it wasn't real bright.
It was just like a dish of some kind of cooking dish, really, is about what it was.
Now, did a door open before these people came out of it?
How did they appear?
How did you meet the little man?
Well, I don't know.
I was feeling it.
I just didn't know if I'd be able to come back down and call the sheriff up
and see if something had fallen off the airplane.
I was kind of wondering too because it was off the ground.
It was about four foot off the ground and had this idling noise.
And I don't know, nothing happened.
I was touching it there for a couple of minutes and I was just getting ready to go.
And from underneath at some point, I don't know, these two things or whatever they are came.
They were about four foot high.
I don't know what they are or what they are or who they were, but they talked to me for about two hours up there.
You could perfectly understand that, huh?
Yeah, they talk better English than you're talking.
with any kind of an accent?
No, no accent or nothing.
I spoke German and Russian
when I was in the service
and nothing like either one of them.
And what did they have to tell you?
What were some of the things they said?
How did they address you?
Well, the first thing they said was,
don't be alarmed.
You've talked to people before.
And they were questioning
how I'd seen them and stuff.
They were quite concerned.
They said I shouldn't have seen them
within 100 feet or so.
And when I told them I saw them way down
where I spent an hour
putting them on our way,
they were quite concerned.
They said I shouldn't have seen them
the day time like that. That's where they land in the day time.
Did they tell you what they were doing there?
Uh huh. They said that they were traveling this hemisphere this trip. They were...
They had... Each one had a tray in their hand full of grass and stuff. It was...
So it looked like they took the knife and cut it right out of the ground with the slab of it in each tray.
That's what they were doing. They said they were collecting organic material and stuff.
Where did they say they were from?
Well, I mean, this sounds awful silly, I know, but they told me they were from what I know as the planet Mars.
Every time they spoke of stuff, they referred to it as I know, or as we know here, like as we know Earth, as we know Mars, and stuff like that.
You sound like you find it rather hard to believe yourself.
Well, I know that I was up there for two hours. I was touching the thing and talking to somebody. I don't know who it was.
And you say you talked to them for about two hours?
I was up there about two hours.
Did they mention anything about bands getting into space,
sort of coming into their territory?
Well, they talk about a lot of stuff.
Some of the stuff we can't say anything about.
Some of it I can, but...
They were talking about the people who were silly to go into space,
that they would never survive there,
just because they can't survive here.
They said they can only make a trip about every two years,
the two that were here.
That they can't stay in this atmosphere.
They were telling me they were much farther advanced in this kind of stuff than we are,
but they were more interested in agriculture, aspects of agriculture, anything.
They asked me what I was doing about the manure, what I got it and what it did and all that
stuff.
They didn't know nothing about agriculture.
They don't have any work on England Trail or anything like that up there.
They said they survive and once they get all the atmosphere they have.
They didn't stress any point.
They made lots of progress.
They never stressed the point. They didn't say how they lived or anything like that.
Did you say that there were other things they told you that you cannot reveal?
No, I mean...
Why not? Why can't you reveal these other things?
I guess I better not say.
Why?
Well, this is being investigated into yet.
Who's investigating it?
I don't know. It's supposed to be the airport. It's supposed to come around, I guess.
You can't tell us what they told you?
Yeah, for my own personal reason.
Can you give us an indication of what it was?
No.
What's of it concern?
Well, concern, them being here, more than anything.
Why they were here.
Did these creatures have features like we do on Earth?
They have eyes?
I don't know.
They were about four foot tall, and they had arms and legs and heads.
Whether they had features, I would presume so.
They just had a complete uniform, covered everything.
I mean, as far as seeing creatures, I couldn't see anything.
The voice comes from the front one someplace.
I don't know.
Couldn't say it come from the head or couldn't say it come from the stomach or where.
I just could hear the voice come from someplace.
He was about four or five feet away from me.
What color were the uniforms?
Same color as the ship.
Sort of like a space suit.
It was the same color.
I didn't touch the uniform.
It looked to me like the same kind of stuff.
They seemed to go back around.
I knew the ship to back when we went first and the front one turned around.
He was shooting. What it went to, I don't know. It was only about 60 seconds until the thing took off.
Now it's standing about six inches from where it took off.
And there you have, reporting from his barn in Newark, New York, Gary Wilcox,
a 28-year-old dairy farmer who says he saw...
Well, you heard Mr. Wilcox. This is Bob Kennedy.
